content:
maria: quick thread  prototyping "binding resolution" for saved views so console shows correct quota/route context instead of generic previews. goal: accurate per-route/per-model previews and avoid stale pins.

sam: agree. do we mutate saved views or keep views immutable and resolve bindings at read time?

jordan: keep immutable. server returns candidate bindings list; client picks best. use scoring: exact route+model > route-only > model-only > global.

tyler: add telemetry_hint in view apply event so quota previews use hinted_sample but do not force runtime sampling. advisory only.

kevin: migration: background suggester that looks at top callers and model usage to propose bindings; owners accept in bulk.

maria: authz: restrict binding creation to route owners plus a 'bindable' role. UI should show a CTA to request binding when blocked.

jordan: DB: normalized view_bindings(view_id, route_id nullable, model_id nullable, sample_hint, created_by, created_at) for indexing.

maria: rollout: feature flag + internal canary, measure quota_preview accuracy and user expectation mismatch.

ops-bot: scheduled canary flip for feature-flag "view-binding-resolve" 2026-03-25T05:00:00Z.
